heroHeadline: 3-Day Ceasefire Expires with No Extension — Russian Attacks Kill 3, Wound 16 on Final Day; Peace Talks Deadlocked Over Donbas
heroSubtitle: The US-brokered three-day ceasefire (May 9–11) expired on May 11 without extension. On the final day, Russian attacks killed 3 civilians and wounded 16 more across Ukraine — 2 killed in Kherson Oblast, 1 in Zaporizhzhia, with 5 more wounded in Kharkiv and 4 in Donetsk. The Ukrainian Air Force also reported Russian drone launches and one Iskander-M ballistic missile fired from occupied Crimea. Ukraine's General Staff recorded 180 front-line clashes. ISW assessed that Russia used the ceasefire window for troop rotations and logistics repositioning. The 1,000-for-1,000 prisoner exchange remains unexecuted. Peace talks are deadlocked: Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the Donetsk territories it still controls; Ukraine refuses to cede any held ground. US Secretary of State Rubio acknowledged peace efforts had 'stagnated.' Russia has now lost an estimated 1,342,030 military personnel since Feb. 24, 2022. Day 1,537 of the full-scale invasion.
